rationale: NominalConversor instances are appended to self._conversors (lines 836, 844) and invoked through the callable-instance protocol. The dense path (_decode_values, line 479) calls conversor(value) on each element of zip(conversors, values), and the COO/LOD paths (539, 599) call conversors[key](value). sklearn/datasets/_arff_parser.py loads with DENSE_GEN and encode_nominal=False for pandas output, so the dense iterated call is the one exercised in-repo. The root gap is callable-instance dispatch through an untyped collection element. Only the keyed sites resemble dynamic-property-keyed-callback (which describes stored functions, not __call__ on instances), so fp-novel is gold and the regression is an arguable alternative.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior fp-classifier-regression verdict correctly finds real callers at 539/599 but overlooks the unkeyed dense-path call at 479, which is the one used in-repo. It also stretches a stored-function rule to cover callable-instance __call__ dispatch.
